definitions.gloss: extraordinary; out of the ordinary; non-everyday
definitions.explanation: Something outside the scope of daily routine. Often used positively to describe special experiences, travel, or events that break from the mundane.

examples.japanese: {非日常|ひにちじょう}を{味|あじ}わう。
{旅行|りょこう}は{非日常|ひにちじょう}の{空間|くうかん}を{楽|たの}しめるのがいい。
examples.english: The nice thing about travel is that you can enjoy an extraordinary space.

examples.japanese: キャンプは{子供|こども}たちに{非日常|ひにちじょう}の{体験|たいけん}をさせるよい{機会|きかい}だ。
examples.english: Camping is a good opportunity to give children an out-of-the-ordinary experience.

notes:
Formed by prefixing {非|ひ} (non-) to {日常|にちじょう} (daily life/routine). Popular in marketing and lifestyle writing to promote travel, events, and luxury experiences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}を{味|あじ}わう (savor the extraordinary)
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}の{体験|たいけん} (extraordinary experience)
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}の{空間|くうかん} (extraordinary space/setting)
- {非日常|ひにちじょう}{的|てき}な (extraordinary, unusual)

Used as a noun ({非日常|ひにちじょう}を{楽|たの}しむ) or as a modifier with の ({非日常|ひにちじょう}の{世界|せかい}). Has a generally positive nuance, unlike the English word "abnormal."
